title: Pin the AWS AgentCore Dockerfile base image to the same node:24-alpine digest
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server/deploy/aws/Dockerfile line 2, replace `FROM node:24-alpine` with the same `FROM docker.io/library/node:24-alpine@sha256:<index-digest>` pinned in task 1, so both images share one vetted base. AgentCore accepts only linux/arm64 images (deploy/aws/README.md), so confirm that the pinned index includes linux/arm64 and build that platform. Rebuild the ECR image, record the new image digest in the release notes, and roll out through dev -> qa -> prod with 1 approval per sdlc/policy.json releaseProcess. Keep the previous ECR image digest for rollback. Complete before the finding SLA of 2026-09-21T13:48:42Z.
acceptanceCriteria: `grep -nE '^FROM ' deploy/aws/Dockerfile` prints exactly one line whose image reference is byte-identical to the FROM reference in the root Dockerfile, including the @sha256 digest
`docker build --platform linux/arm64 -f deploy/aws/Dockerfile .` succeeds at the merged commit, and the rebuilt ECR image digest plus the previous digest kept for rollback appear in the release notes

verificationMethod.description: Re-run /probe-cicd-env example-co on mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server at the merged commit. Expected: no CICD-PIN-02 result for location deploy/aws/Dockerfile, and the finding's evidence file shows a digest-pinned FROM.

rootCause.description: The AgentCore Dockerfile under deploy/aws was copied with the same floating node:24-alpine tag and has no digest. Its ARM64 ECR image can therefore pick up a different base than the Docker Hub image built from the root Dockerfile.
